files.quarantine/TESTING-SOP.md:
# Water testing SOP

Ammonia and nitrite are tested for every quarantine tank each morning and logged the same day. A blank ammonia cell means the test did not complete; never copy the previous day's reading into the log. Retests are backfilled with the tester's initials.
